questions.question: After 8 games so far this season, who is currently third in the Premier League table today, Monday 26th Oct 2026?
questions.clue: This team is famously nicknamed "The Seagulls".
questions.funFact: This south-coast club plays their home games at the Amex Stadium and are nickname-inspired by sea birds.

questions.question: Newcastle United legend Steve Howey celebrates his birthday today, 26th October. What year was he born?
questions.clue: He was born in the early 1970s, the same year Apollo 14 landed on the Moon.
questions.funFact: He was an integral part of Kevin Keegan's famous "Entertainers" side that challenged for the Premier League title in the 1990s.

questions.question: Who is the current manager of Liverpool?
questions.clue: He is a Spanish tactician who previously spent time managing in Dorset.
questions.funFact: He made a name for himself managing Rayo Vallecano and Bournemouth before taking over at Anfield.

questions.question: Which Brighton player scored an own goal in their 2-nil defeat away to Liverpool yesterday (Sunday)?
questions.clue: This German midfielder is known for his incredible set-piece delivery and versatility.
questions.funFact: He is one of Brighton's all-time top goal creators in Premier League history.

questions.question: And in the same match, which Liverpool player got the 2nd goal at Anfield yesterday?
questions.clue: This Swedish international striker moved to the Premier League in a marquee transfer.
questions.funFact: He broke Sweden's national team record as their youngest-ever goalscorer at age 17 before moving to England.

questions.question: Manchester United were beaten again yesterday (Sunday); who beat them?
questions.clue: This club is nicknamed "The Cherries" and plays at the Vitality Stadium.
questions.funFact: The Cherries achieved a historic victory against the Red Devils on their own home patch.

questions.question: Raheem Sterling was given which shirt number for Manchester City when he joined in 2015?
questions.clue: It is a lucky single-digit number traditionally associated with legendary wingers.
questions.funFact: He scored 131 goals in 339 appearances for Manchester City across all competitions while wearing this shirt.

questions.question: Which current premiership team has been in the top flight of English football for the longest continuous streak?
questions.clue: This North London club hasn't been relegated from the top flight in over a century.
questions.funFact: They have maintained their top-flight status uninterrupted since 1919.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has John Terry won during his career?
questions.clue: The number of titles he won equals the number of fingers on a hand.
questions.funFact: He captained Chelsea to five Premier League titles, making him one of the most successful captains in league history.

questions.question: How many Premier League Golden Boot awards did Michael Owen win during his career?
questions.clue: An even number representing his early career dominance.
questions.funFact: Owen shared or won the award back-to-back in 1997-98 and 1998-99, netting 18 goals in each campaign as a teenager.
